Their only writer is 0x557a19 (DAT_00852c44 = (int)(short)esi[2]; DAT_00852c48 = (int)(short)esi[3]: movsx of track-file words), so both dwords are sign-extended i16 values. Full-range u32 values (state_00403800 alone) are impossible and push |ecx-edge|<<14 past the 'div [0x622354]' range at 0x403c19 (#DE in the original). Overlay this after state_00403800.
